notes: Good early steal, then it spent turns 8-11 running HQ over and over: first into a known tag ice that resolved its subs, then at 0 credits into Starlit Knight ETR (11 runs that did nothing). It never contested the remote where the Corp scored three agendas.
Solid pressure on remotes and HQ with the right breakers and well-timed steals. The only oddities were repeated HQ accesses into the same La Costa Grid and taking Urtica damage early.
After an early R&D steal it clicked for credits every turn up to 43 credits with a full grip, never installed anything and never contested the remote. The Corp scored four agendas uncontested.
Efficient HQ pressure with Marjanah, trashed the Nico Campaign and broke Eli to close out a fast win. Clean play overall.
Steady R&D pressure through Congratulations! won the game, but it clicked for credits a lot and never ran HQ. It also often ended turns tagged against a Corp holding 40 credits.

It spent all its credits on turn 1 and then facechecked. Later it made repeated Red Team runs into known Hagen/Ablative Barrier ETR it could not break, then clicked for credits up to 24 while the Corp advanced and scored in Server 5 (it used Tread Lightly on the wrong server).

It won through stubborn R&D digging, but its economy sat at 0-3 credits for over ten turns with a full unused grip. It took repeated tags from Funhouse and never contested the remote where the Corp scored three agendas.
It made one bounce run, then clicked for credits every turn up to 63 credits with five cards in grip and never installed a breaker. The Corp scored four remote agendas unopposed.
Strong Finality/sabotage R&D pressure won quickly. Taking Urtica damage from a speculative remote run was a reasonable gamble, and it left the advanced Server 3 card alone.
Good use of Fermenter, Boi-tata and Rising Tide to pressure R&D and the remote. Early breakerless Chastushka and a low-credit final facecheck against Jinteki were slightly loose.
Smart use of Tao swaps to put Paywall on R&D and win through multi-access runs. It stacked many tags against a rich NBN Corp, which was risky but went unpunished.
Banner carried steady HQ/R&D pressure to the win, with thin economy and a lot of clicking for credits. It did not get into the remote that scored Transport Monopoly.
It clicked for credits nearly every turn up to 89 credits with a full grip, made only one meaningful run turn and never contested Server 1. The Corp scored repeatedly there.
After Red Team ran out, it hoarded credits up to 49 by clicking and ignored remotes where agendas were installed and advanced over multiple turns. It lost to uncontested scoring.
Good early R&D/HQ accesses and Docklands Pass use led to a win. It took avoidable net damage several times (facechecks into Anemone/Diviner) and lost Tremolo and other key cards.
Repeated Red Team runs into known Hagen and Eli ETR with no way to break them, then clicked for credits up to 26 while the Corp scored three remote agendas.
Good Banner-based HQ pressure, including sacrificing Banner to steal SDS and reinstalling it. A fast, coherent win.
After turn 3 it clicked for credits every turn up to 56 credits with a full grip, ignoring the remotes. It made a single bounce run as the Corp scored out.
Spotted weak ice, used Tread Lightly on the remote and stole two Melies agendas for a quick win. Efficient play.
Most turns it only clicked for credits (up to 49) with a full grip and ignored an empty HQ. The Corp advanced and scored three agendas in Server 2 over several turns while it watched.
